title: Leak in the distribution network — Compressor starts and loads too often
cause: Air escapes from the pipework, hoses or couplings behind the reservoirs, so the unit has to replace what the plant loses. The loss runs day and night, which is what separates it from a busy shift.
checks: Stop the unit, close the isolation valve at the pneumatic panel and watch whether the reservoir pressure still falls.
Walk the distribution network and listen at joints, couplings and hose ends.
Compare the pressure decay of a quiet night with the reference cycle.
remedy: Seal or replace the leaking joints, hoses and couplings, then repeat the pressure-hold test with the unit stopped and the plant isolated. Record the decay you measure so the next comparison starts from a known figure.

manual_ref.title: Compressor starts and loads too often

evidence.observation: The compressor loaded nine times in the last hour against a reference of four.
Line pressure falls faster while the unit is idle than the reference cycle allows, at night as well as by day.
